name: Thran Khorman
summary: At Anvilmar, Thran Khorman readies new warriors for the dangers of Coldridge Valley.

sections.title: Drillmaster of Coldridge Valley
sections.body: Thran Khorman drills dwarven recruits and visiting gnomes on Anvilmar’s grounds. Gruff and demanding, he has little patience for anyone without the grit for front-line fighting. The Third War has ended, yet troggs still press into Coldridge Pass. So Thran demands relentless practice with axe, mace, and shield, keeping Ironforge’s defenders ready.

faq.answer: At Anvilmar in Dun Morogh, Thran Khorman trains warriors. He gives novice warriors their first combat instruction in Coldridge Valley.
Thran teaches novice warriors stances and melee techniques. He prepares them to face troggs and wild beasts in the pass.

faq.q: Why is he dismissed or curt with certain travelers?
faq.answer: Thran has little patience for those who pursue arcane, shadow, or subtle arts. If you are not a warrior, he will tell you plainly that you would not survive a day under his training.

angles.text: As a dwarven or gnomish warrior awakening in Coldridge Pass, Thran is the first master to test your mettle. He gives you your starter runes or orders and teaches you the basics of martial survival.
As a dwarf, you can see the stubborn resolve of Ironforge’s defenders in Thran. He keeps them ready even in peacetime, so the kingdom is never caught unprepared.
